items.description: Leak detection call-out and electro-acoustic pinpointing of the leak beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(e) covers investigation to locate the source of damage; reference cases 21 and 27 show this line is indemnified at a combined rate for call-out and pinpointing, with t >= 1400 for a flat rate covering both.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(e) covers measurement to establish extent of moisture; reference case 21 and price prior indicate t per pc about 167 (range 123-253), so for 1 pc use 167.
Policy 7.1.7(g) covers skilled labour at customary rates; price prior and reference cases (e.g., 21, 56) show t per hr about 93, so for 14 hrs use 1307 (range 1192-1427).
Policy 7.1.7(f) covers one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; price prior and references (e.g., 51, 56) show t per pc about 83 (range 78-88).

items.description: Freeing the affected pipe run beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(a) covers dismantling to access affected components; reference case 21 shows t between 117 and 158 for this work.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged pipe insulation
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(a) covers removal/disposal of affected materials; reference case 21 shows t >= 136 for 2 pcs, so use 136.

items.description: Repair of the confirmed leak on the copper supply pipe
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(c) covers repair of affected pipe; reference case 21 shows t between 157 and 220 for this work.

items.description: Replacement copper pipe section and transition fittings
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(c) covers standard-grade replacement materials; reference case 21 shows t between 49 and 66 for transition pieces and insulation, but here the line is for a longer section (1-2m) so reference case 18 (>=221) and 56 (>=211 for 6.4m) suggest t about 220.
Policy 7.1.7(f) covers one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; price prior and references show t per pc about 83.

items.description: Condensation dryer for the kitchen, rental for the drying period
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(b) covers drying equipment rental for affected rooms; reference case 21 shows t between 20 and 65 for a condensation dryer.

items.description: Room drying of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(b) covers drying of affected areas; price prior and reference case 21 show t per pc about 57 (range 24-138).
Policy 7.1.7(f) covers one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; price prior and references show t per pc about 83.

items.description: Removal, transport and disposal of the water-damaged wooden kitchen table
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(h) covers removal, transport and disposal of damaged furnishing items; reference case 21 shows removal (55-60) and disposal (>=95 for 2 pcs), so for 3 pcs (combined) estimate t about 150.

items.description: Supply of replacement table - premium solid-oak designer model, higher specification than the original
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.1(d) and 7.1.9: indemnity is limited to the current value of an item of the same kind and specification as the original (plain pine, 2019, daily use, visible wear); reference case 21 shows t between 524 and 527 for a comparable new table, but here must deduct for age and wear (table is 7 years old, well-used). Estimate current value at about 40% of new (210).

items.description: Delivery and assembly of the replacement table
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(h) covers delivery and assembly of replacement furnishing items; reference case 21 shows t between 59 and 60.
Policy 7.1.7(h) covers cleaning of the area where the damaged item stood; reference case 21 shows t between 78 and 85.
Policy 7.1.7(f) covers one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; price prior and references show t per pc about 83.
